reviews.reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands in I4/mmm (No. 139) to 26 fully occupied atoms, Tb2Ga8Co16 (Z=2), while primitive standardization gives the 13-atom reduced formula Tb(GaCo2)4; its a=8.37056 A, c=4.94080 A cell and stated Ga-8i/Co-8j,8f ordering are internally consistent. All 44 observed peaks with prominence >=0.8 match calculated CIF reflections within 0.019 degrees 2theta, with no important unexplained line. The instantiated atomic model has strong whole-profile support: the trace's refined 8i model gives SSE 269.2 over 8501 points (RMS 0.178; independently reproduced unweighted profile residual 4.12%), close to a 51-line Pawley-like lower bound of 3.59%, whereas Ga on 8f or 8j remains roughly an order of magnitude worse in trace SSE (2336.7 and 2780.3) even with extra profile/thermal freedom. The refined coordinates converge consistently, and the other multiplicity-2 Tb placement is grossly incompatible with the profile. Periodic shells show no overlaps or chemically impossible contacts (shortest Co-Co 2.440 A, Co-Ga 2.552 A, Ga-Ga 2.625 A, Tb-Ga 2.873 A, Tb-Co 3.101 A); stoichiometry and occupancies are exact. Thus an explicit ordered realization is established and the diffraction-relevant ordering alternatives are quantitatively rejected, with no concrete viable incompatible branch left uncovered.
